title: World Advanced Daisenryaku: Koutetsu no Senpuu
native_title: ワールド・アドバンスド 大戦略 ～鋼鉄の戦風～
overview:
Hoping this tragedy is never repeated

In Campaign Mode, you can choose your nation from Germany, America and Japan.

About 500 types of real historical weapons realistically recreated.

World Advanced Daisenryaku: Koutetsu no Senpuu is a turn-based World War II strategy game. Command the armies of Germany, Japan or the United States across hex maps of historical battles, moving tanks, artillery, aircraft and warships and watching each clash play out in battle scenes. Win impressively in Campaign Mode and the course of the war can change, leading your forces into hypothetical operations such as the invasion of the British Isles. A Standard mode is also available.

- Campaign and Standard modes
- 1 to 5 players
- Shuttle Mouse support
- Memory backup support

この悲劇が二度と繰り返されないことを願って

キャンペーンモードでは、ドイツ・アメリカ・日本から自国の選択が可能。

約500種類の実在した兵器をリアルに再現。
